about_the_game:
DÜWAG GT6 – The Classic Articulated Tram

The DÜWAG GT6 is a legend of the tram world – now available as a true-to-life simulation for your virtual fleet! This historic vehicle from the 1950s and 60s offers not only nostalgic charm, but also authentic driving behavior and a variety of realistic gameplay features.

Classic with demanding technology

The GT6 impresses with its crank-operated cam controller, giving you full control over acceleration and deceleration. The mechanical rollsign display can be adjusted directly from the cockpit using dynamic route codes to perfectly display your line.

The integrated IBIS system provides current route data and destination information – for a realistic driving experience on every route. The interior lighting with light bulbs creates an atmospheric ambiance, making the time travel experience complete.

High-level gameplay

  • Sensitive crank controller for precise driving and braking

  • Dynamically adjustable rollsign with realistic line displays

  • IBIS system for up-to-date route and destination info

  • Authentic interior lighting with bulbs

  • Extensive shunting system for flexible maneuvers

  • Various livery options to customize the GT6 to your preferences

Technical Data

  • Year of manufacture: 1958–1967

  • Length: 19 m | Width: 2.2 m

  • Weight: 19.4 t

  • Seats: 43 | Standing capacity: 78

  • Top speed: 60 km/h

  • Drive system: 2 x 120 kW DC series-wound motors

  • Brakes: Solenoid holding brake, hand parking brake

Seamless Integration with City Transport Simulator: Bus

City Transport Simulator: Tram is a full standalone experience built on the same powerful platform as City Transport Simulator: Bus. While each title offers a complete public transport simulation on its own, owning both unlocks something even greater.

Experience a connected city, where trams and buses operate side by side in one shared world. Switch between vehicle types seamlessly, follow coordinated timetables, and run an interlinked network from one dynamic menu.

This is more than just another tram simulation — it's part of a modular simulator system that grows with you.

Built for Long-Term Support

City Transport Simulator: Tram is a deep, customizable simulation of public transport, made by enthusiasts for enthusiasts — and it’s only getting bigger. With ongoing updates, new vehicles, new cities, and more on the way.

Are you ready to take control of the city?
